note: §12: D2 prepares the executable protocol and runs NO stochastic calibration, NO Treatment trial and NO paid model call. Nothing here is an experimental result.

estimand.question: What is the incremental effect of source-qualified Trajectory history BEYOND existing Canonical Work Context and PriorResultContext?
estimand.treatment: the SAME Existing Context + a source-qualified Trajectory Section delivered through the attempt-bound boundary

deliveryPrecondition.mechanism: the C6 experimental Attempt-bound delivery (profile `trajectory` section, DEFAULT OFF), which materializes the qualified Capsule and renders the model-visible section before the first engineering turn
deliveryPrecondition.trialClassification: a Treatment trial whose delivery-precondition state is NOT `SECTION_RENDERED`/`CONTROL_SECTION_RENDERED` must be classified DELIVERY_PRECONDITION_NOT_MET and NOT counted as a valid delivered Treatment; it must never be interpreted as evidence that Trajectory has no utility
deliveryPrecondition.currentStatus: qualified / selected / materialized / rendered / placed (L1) / session-recorded (L2) are proven; Model Turn started and beyond are NOT run in this stage

baselineOnlyCalibration.required: D2 begins with baseline-only calibration BEFORE any Treatment execution
baselineOnlyCalibration.method: run the CONTROL arm alone across the frozen dimensions and measure the per-dimension distribution
baselineOnlyCalibration.ifSaturated: BENCHMARK_NOT_QUALIFIED — NOT a reason to increase the number of Treatment trials

plannedControlRepetitions: to be fixed AFTER baseline calibration; D2 specifies the plan, not a count
randomizationAndPairing: paired by fixture and initial Git state; the arm is the only difference between paired runs
stopConditions: a saturated baseline (all dimensions invariant) ⇒ BENCHMARK_NOT_QUALIFIED
a delivery-precondition failure ⇒ the trial is not counted
a fixture whose claimed failure is not Capsule-visible ⇒ the fixture is not treatment-relevant
r2eR2vrLessonsPreserved: voluntary retrieval ≠ host-mediated delivery ≠ model-visible content ≠ model behavior ≠ task success
lack of voluntary retrieval is NOT evidence that history is useless
a delivered Section is NOT evidence that a model understood it
a benchmark with only unrelated residual variation does NOT measure Trajectory utility
requiredFutureAuthorizations: explicit authorization to run stochastic model repetitions
a provider/model selection and a cost ceiling
an independent outcome oracle for the chosen fixture
permittedFinalStatements: baseline calibration has NOT been run
expectedInvariant: the protocol is executable, frozen and honest about what has NOT been measured; no positive utility conclusion is drawn
remainingUncertainty: everything downstream of 'Model Turn started' is unmeasured; a future stage must run baseline calibration first and may return BENCHMARK_NOT_QUALIFIED
